children.name: Audio Coding Mode
children.value: 7: 3/2 (left, center, right, left surround, right surround)

findings.message: The dac3 box gives acmod 7, but the frames hold 2; players that set up their decoder from the box and those that read the frames differ.
The dac3 box gives lfeon 1, but the frames hold 0; players that set up their decoder from the box and those that read the frames differ.
The dac3 box gives bit_rate_code 14, but the frames hold 10; players that set up their decoder from the box and those that read the frames differ.
Reserved bits of the dac3 box are not 0, as ETSI TS 102 366 Annex F requires.
